## Review checklist

There is no second reviewer, so this list and green checks stand in for one. Delete lines that do not apply.

- [ ] Every acceptance criterion in scope is covered by a test, or is listed under "Still manual" below
- [ ] The Netlify deploy preview shows the criteria working
- [ ] No new accessibility violations (axe is part of the end-to-end checks)
- [ ] No performance or bundle-size budget broken
- [ ] No console errors in a normal session
- [ ] `CLAUDE.md` and `docs/decisions.md` updated if commands, structure or decisions changed
- [ ] `design/` untouched (changes to it go through Peter)
- [ ] Anything unfinished is behind a feature flag that is off in production
